project.name: springAIMcpServerCommon :: Chat UI
project.description: Embeddable chat interface <saimcp-chat> (Web Component, F-53) for the agent stream (dai-stream/1, LLD-13): resizable window, Markdown with tables, code highlighting (CEL included) and Mermaid, step details, choices, feedback and copy. Plain ES modules with no build step and no runtime dependencies, served by Spring Boot's static resource handling from META-INF/resources at /dynamic-ai/ui/chat/. Opt-in: not part of the starter. JavaScript tests run with Node (scripts/chat-ui-test.sh).
